body.title: applyMigration applies metaRewrites inside the per-group commits and rollback
body.summary: Change the zero-moves early return to require no moves AND no metaRewrites. After link rewrites, for each MetaRewrite: JSON.parse the artifact (error names the artifact), set only the listed meta fields, write back as JSON.stringify(..., null, 2) + '\n', git add; for each md edit, count exact whole-line matches of `from` in the file (error naming file + line when not exactly one), replace, git add. Commit per group with the moves' paths plus the group's JSON and md paths; groups with only rewrites get a 'chore(docs): realign <hash> artifact labels' commit. With zero moves the vacated set is empty and link validation still runs. All inside the existing try so failures reset --hard to startSha. Narrow the existing '.insrc/artifacts byte-identical after apply' test assertion to consistent members, since stale members are now expected to change.
acceptanceChecks: After apply, deriveMdPath on every member's stored meta equals its md location and PLAN.md shows the head label
Only the planned meta fields change; consistent members stay byte-identical (existing byte-identical assertion narrowed accordingly and passing)
A group's moves and rewrites land in one commit; a rewrite-only group gets its own realign commit
A rewrite-only plan applies (no early return; prune is a no-op and link validation passes)
A committed missing label line or corrupt JSON throws the rewrite-step error after an earlier chunk committed, and HEAD + work tree equal the start commit
Re-planning after apply yields no moves and no metaRewrites
